title: Inverse image of set-valued sheaves on small etale sites is exact
statement: Let $h:T'\to T$ be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. On the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], base change $V\mapsto V\times_TT'$ gives a continuous functor $T_{\Et}\to T'_{\Et}$ [lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-continuous]. Its induced inverse-image functor $h^{-1}:\operatorname{Sh}(T_{\Et})\to\operatorname{Sh}(T'_{\Et})$ on sheaves of sets, left adjoint to $h_*F(V)=F(V\times_TT')$, preserves finite limits and finite colimits; hence this base-change functor defines a morphism of sites $T'_{\Et}\to T_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology](3).

source.place: Lemma Tag 03Q1 (lemma-stalk-pullback), assertion (2), and Section Tag 03PZ (section-inverse-image), Definition 59.36.1

proof.text: Apply AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.isContinuous_overPullback to h to obtain continuity of the base-change functor. This is [lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-continuous].

Use the constructed Mathlib sheaf adjunction Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous, giving precisely the left Kan extension followed by sheafification as left adjoint to continuous pushforward, as in [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-functor-sheaf-pullback-adjunction]. Package this adjunction in Nonempty and install its isLeftAdjoint instance.

Base change preserves finite limits by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-finite-limits], hence is representably flat. Its opposite left Kan extension is left exact by the large-category version CategoryTheory.preservesFiniteLimits_op_lan_of_flat of [lem-weil-pbc-presheaf-pullback-sets-left-exact]. The indexing comma categories have objects in universe u+1 and morphisms in universe u. For Type (u+1), install AB5OfSize.{u,u+1} using AB5OfSize_of_univLE from the usual AB5 instance; this is filtered colimits commuting with finite limits, [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimits-commute-finite-limits]. Inclusion of sheaves preserves finite limits by [lem-weil-pbc-presheaf-finite-limits-objectwise], and sheafification does by [lem-weil-pbc-sheafification-sets-exact]. Thus the composite constructed sheaf pullback preserves finite limits; typeclass inference composes these instances.

The adjunction from step 2 makes the constructed inverse image a left adjoint, so typeclass inference applies preservation of colimits and then finite colimits, [lem-weil-pbc-left-adjoint-preserves-colimits]. Combine continuity, the adjunction witness, finite-limit preservation, and finite-colimit preservation by conjunction introduction.
